candidates.explanation: The component directly accesses the 'Statistics' service through its '.shared' property, creating a hard-coded dependency that is difficult to isolate or substitute during testing.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: The task contains a while loop that repeats work without internal cancellation checks.

candidates.explanation: The long-running loop within the 'timerTask' does not check for 'Task.isCancelled' inside the loop body (it only checks before entering the loop), allowing the task to continue running after cancellation until the next sleep cycle or completion.
candidates.title: Long-Running Task Ignores Cancellation
